Thanks for the intro — Elena and I are keen to see Redwood in action. Our CFO is wrapping up a lot this week but we can do a demo next week.

Would Dec 8 at 10:00 AM PT work for a 45-minute demo (team: IT + Procurement + Elena)? Also can you share a mutual action plan and a draft SOW so procurement can start a review?

Subject: Re: Intro demo: Redwood for ACME — scheduling

Hi Sanjay (and Elena),

Great to hear — thanks for the prompt reply. Dec 8 is currently open on our side, but a quick note: I just heard the ACME CFO will be traveling the following week and the procurement/finance review is being held until the quarter forecast is finalized. To avoid repeating reviews, would you be open to shifting the demo to the week of Dec 15 (Dec 15–17)? That should let the CFO and procurement join live and align the demo to the FY forecast decisions.

I attached a draft mutual action plan (MAP) to get procurement started; I can update it after we lock the date. I also included a short agenda so we can tailor the walkthrough to the stakeholders you expect (finance questions / cost-per-token economics / deployment options).

Proposed options:
- Dec 15 09:00 AM PT — 45 min (preferred, CFO back in town)
- Dec 16 11:00 AM PT — 45 min
- Dec 17 02:00 PM PT — 45 min

If any of those work I’ll send a calendar invite and include our security lead and solutions engineer.

Apologies for the slight shuffle — want to make sure we have decision makers in the room to streamline procurement and avoid a follow-up later.

Best,

Irene Choi

irene_choi@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0183

Quick note — heard from a contact at ACME: CFO will be in EMEA on a road trip through Dec 12. Strong preference from their procurement is to have the CFO present for pricing and cost-model discussion (reasonable). I recommend we hold to Dec 15–17 options and have a brief prep with procurement/security before the demo so we can surface the SSO/KMS and audit-log items up front.

Irene: I can join the prep call — propose Dec 10 or 11 for a 30-minute pre-demo alignment.

— Rishi

Thanks for your flexibility. Following up after internal coordination: to make the procurement review as efficient as possible (and so the CFO can attend), can we move the demo to

Dec 15, 2026 at 09:00 AM PT — 45 minutes

We’ll cover: brief architecture + deployment options (hosted/dedicated/private), token cost model tuned to your Q1 forecast, and a short procurement/security appendix (SSO, KMS, audit logs). I’ve attached an updated MAP (v2) and a draft SOW for procurement to start redlines.

Links / next steps:
- HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/ACME-2026-0931
- MAP v2 + SOW attached (see attachments)
- Proposed pre-demo alignment: Dec 10 or Dec 11 (30 min) to run through procurement questions

Please reply with which of the above you prefer and I’ll send the calendar invite and include our solutions engineer and security lead.

Sorry for the shuffle — want to avoid two rounds of procurement review after your forecast closes.
